title: Adapter Discontinued Replaced with 72232 - ½" Open Hose
lead: Due to customer preference and ease of use, the 94767 adapter is being discontinued and replaced with the ½" open-hose adapter (Part # 72232) for use with the Ford 90° ATF quick disconnect adapter (Part # 94693). The ½" open- hose adapter is easier to disconnect after a service, especially in tight areas.
